Chapter 4 — System admin

Account, data sync, networking, and software updates around PanelsDCC. Content in this chapter will expand over time.

Your profile and devices

Manage your PanelsDCC account and authorised devices here as features become available.

Syncing data

Configuration is authored in the cloud and synced to your layout runtime; this section will describe sync behaviour and troubleshooting.

Wi‑Fi configuration

For day-to-day Wi‑Fi and hotspot use in PanelsDCC Connect, see Getting started — Configure Wi‑Fi and the Wi‑Fi tab in Connect.

Update management

PanelsDCC packages are installed on the Raspberry Pi. Re-run the install script or use your package flow when updates are published:

curl -fsSL https://panelsd.cc/install.sh | sudo bash
